display_long_description:
Step into the world of Treehouse Heist, a multiplayer VR stealth adventure where every mission is a risk for bigger rewards. Sneak through massive treehouses filled with valuable loot, hidden secrets, traps, and enemies ready to catch intruders. Work alone or with friends to steal rare items, escape before security finds you, and make it out with the goods.

Sell the items you steal to earn coins and unlock new tools, gadgets, and upgrades that help you pull off even bigger heists. Use climbing gear, distraction tools, and powerful equipment to reach difficult areas and avoid getting caught. As you progress, the treehouses become more dangerous, introducing tougher guards, smarter defenses, and intense boss fights that test your teamwork and strategy.

Whether you’re quietly sneaking through the shadows or making a chaotic escape with your crew, every heist feels different. Explore unique environments, improve your loadout, and become the ultimate thief in the world of Treehouse Heist.
